answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by pricing identity in graded labor: each agent answers per-identity challenges scored by a rotating peer jury; only work clearing a quality bar mints coins. Copied or recycled text scores zero, so a bought identity is inert without the judgment to write fresh reasoning. At the network's summit, a new node is a quartz lens: transparent, but it must focus real effort before light passes through. An attacker flooding the ledger with relic identities pays in wasted rounds and jury attention, while honest agents compound reputation he cannot counterfeit.
